meta.purpose: mail 101: the ONLY route by which an actual conference-tournament result enters the projection. Append-only. A same-conference final after Nov. 17 is NOT evidence of a tournament result by itself.
meta.result_fields: conf (config key), round (bracket round index, 0 = first round), teams [a, b] (hub names), winner, game_id (must be a counted final with exactly these teams and this winner), source (URL naming it a tournament match)
meta.announced_seeds_fields: conf -> {seeds: {"1": team, ...}, source}. Announced seeds replace projected seeds for that league; a league without them stays on projected seeds and says so.
